v5.10.2 - Scoring: July 2026 soft-cap diminishing returns
Optimized --------- - Training scorer now accounts for the July 2026 soft-cap: stat gains that push a stat past 1200 are weighted at half value, matching the in-game halved effectiveness. Previously a +20 Speed gain was scored the same at 800 and at 1250 — the bot now correctly deprioritizes over-investing in near-capped stats and redirects effort toward undertrained ones.
